name: Angel Crown
source:
Odd disease turns people into trees. The only know cure is send brain impulse by having sex with women. Main character agrees to be hospitalized to a special ward and starts his way to be cured.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一种怪病会让患者逐渐变成树木。唯一已知的疗法，是与女性性交，将脑部脉冲传入对方体内。主人公同意入住特殊病房，就此踏上治疗之路。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
